services: All owned project services stopped; separate browser API stopped/auto-removed. No running work abandoned.
volume_policy: Retained intentionally for audit/reconciliation, including application history, K3s identity and executor authority. No unknown lock was released and no authority journal was deleted to enable writes.
probe_cleanup: Only probe-created secondary sender containers/configuration removed; worker restored before final stop.
browser_cleanup: Owned lab sessions signed out and owned tabs released; temporary private clipboard contexts disposed and grants removed. Unrelated Edge tabs and Edge permission/certificate settings untouched.
unrelated_resources: No synapse-* container or unrelated host Kubernetes context was changed.

retained_disposable_accounts.scope: Owned cloudops-issue39-live database only; fixture accounts are retained with the audit history, not removed or reused as real accounts. Includes failed/interrupted probe attempts and native-browser Operator/Viewer. No credentials are recorded.

correction_cleanup.authority_boundary: No executor restart, new-UID authority, unknown replay or unknown unlock during corrections. Original application/K3s/authority volumes retained.
